name: Last winter's coldest stretch (replay)
capacityNote: Hypothetical: capacity set 3 MMcf/day below this scenario's peak-day demand. Daily limit per gas day; within-day swings are covered by linepack and storage (assumed).
source: ACIS StnData daily max/min and HDD, ANCHORAGE TED STEVENS INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (PANC), 2026-01-02 to 2026-01-05 (data/raw/acis_panc_2025-11_2026-03.json); coldest 72 h (12:00 day 1 to 12:00 day 4) between 2025-11-01 and 2026-03-31. Hourly temperatures by assumed cosine interpolation (min 07:00, max 15:00). systemMMcfh = (a + b × daily HDD) × demand_shape, from data/system_fit.json; daily HDD 68, 72, 73, 60.

forecastRuns.label: sourced
forecastRuns.source: IEM MOS archive, PANC, NBS run 2026-01-01T07Z (data/raw/iem_mos_nbs_panc_lastwinter.json), with NBE for the days beyond its range (data/raw/iem_mos_nbe_panc_lastwinter.json). Hourly values: the run's daily max/min (TXN) through the same cosine interpolation as the observed series (min 07:00, max 15:00); spread from XND.
